faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Unsure about something? Here are answers to common questions.
faq.a1: Turvasiipi is a free digital tool for documenting, identifying, and addressing workplace bullying and inappropriate treatment. We provide information, tools, and peer support to everyone who encounters inappropriate behavior.
faq.q2: Who sees the things I write?
faq.a2: No one but you. All information is stored **only on your own device** (phone or computer). We don't have a server that collects your data, nor do we see your logbooks or reports.
faq.q3: Can my employer see that I use this?
faq.a3: No. The app doesn't require logging in with work email, nor does it leave traces on the company's network (except browser history). We recommend using the app on your own device or in Private Browsing (Incognito) mode.
faq.a4: You record events in the "Timeline" section. The information is saved in your device's memory. When you need evidence, you can create an automatic PDF summary of all your entries in the "Report" section, for example for occupational health or safety.
faq.q5: Is the story I share in the Stories section visible to others?
faq.a5: Yes, but only if you choose to publish it. Publishing is fully anonymous (or with a pseudonym of your choice). We don't store IP addresses, so stories cannot be traced back to you.
faq.q6: I am in immediate danger. What should I do?
faq.a6: If you experience violence or an acute threat, call the emergency number **112** immediately. Turvasiipi is a documentation tool, not a crisis service. In mental distress, call the Crisis Hotline: **010 195 202**.
faq.q7: How does Turvasiipi help me recover?
faq.a7: Beyond passive documentation, the app provides active tools: simulators and coaching modules. They allow you to practice difficult situations safely, strengthen your resilience, and learn to set boundaries tactically.
faq.q8: Is the use of AI safe?
faq.a8: Yes. We use AI only to structure reports, and it happens in a highly secure environment. Your data is not used for AI training, and it is never permanently stored in any cloud service.
faq.a9: Bullying literacy is the ability to recognize, understand, and confront bullying in the work community – in time and together. It doesn't mean that every individual should be an expert or a hero. It means that no one is helpless in the situation.

employer-notice-tsl28.title: First notice to employer
employer-notice-tsl28.description: Official notification of inappropriate treatment, obligating the employer to take action.
employer-notice-tsl28.subject: Notification of inappropriate treatment (Occupational Safety and Health Act, Section 28)
employer-notice-tsl28.content:
Dear [Manager's Name / HR Director],

I am making this notification in accordance with Section 28 of the Occupational Safety and Health Act.

BACKGROUND
I have been working at [Company] in [Role] since [Start Date]. Over the past [Period], I have experienced systematic inappropriate treatment that affects my occupational safety and health.

EVENTS
[AI combination of events]

IMPACT
Curated treatment described above has caused me significant burden, manifested as [AI symptoms: e.g. sleep problems and decreased work vigor].

REQUEST FOR ACTION
Section 28 of the Occupational Safety and Health Act obligates the employer to take measures to investigate and stop the situation without delay. I request:
1. Written confirmation of receipt of this notification
2. Information on what measures will be taken in the matter
3. A schedule for the investigation process

I have documented the events accurately and am ready to provide additional information.

Sincerely,
[Your Name]
[Date]

employer-follow-up.title: Follow-up message (when no response is received)
employer-follow-up.description: Use this 7-14 days after the first message if the employer remains silent.
employer-follow-up.subject: Follow-up: Notification of inappropriate treatment ([Original Date])
employer-follow-up.content:
Dear [Recipient],

I sent a notification of inappropriate treatment on [Date] (attached). I have not received a response within a reasonable time.

Section 28 of the Occupational Safety and Health Act obligates the employer to take action WITHOUT DELAY after being informed. I request a response to the following questions by [Date + 7 days] at the latest:
1. Has my notification been received?
2. Who is handling the matter?
3. What is the estimated schedule for the investigation?

If I do not receive a response, I will have to contact my labor union or the occupational safety authority to resolve the situation.

Sincerely,
[Name]

career-interview-prep.title: Answering in job interviews
career-interview-prep.description: How to explain changing jobs without being labeled a "difficult employee".
career-interview-prep.subject: Job interview response template (oral)
career-interview-prep.content:
GENERAL RULE: Do not badmouth your previous employer. Focus on the future.

OPTION A (Neutral):
"In my previous employment, I identified that the organizational culture and management style no longer matched my values or enabled my development. Therefore, I decided to seek an environment where open communication and cooperation are valued, as they are here."

OPTION B (Slightly more open):
"In my previous job, a challenging management situation was encountered. I did my best to resolve the situation, but ultimately concluded that it is best to move on and focus energy on a new challenge."

OPTION C (Honest):
"I experienced inappropriate treatment at my previous workplace, which despite efforts, could not be resolved. I documented the situation carefully and handled my departure professionally. This experience has taught me a lot about a healthy work culture and how important mutual respect is."

hero.description: Psychological bullying is subtler and often more destructive than physical violence. This tool helps you name your experience.

results.disclaimer: "This is not normal workplace stress. This is not your fault."

stable.label: Stable Situation
stable.description: Your experiences currently suggest a stable work situation. Continue to nurture a good culture.

mild.label: Mild Attention
mild.description: Some signs of uncertainty are in the air. Monitor the situation and trust your instinct – often recognition is hardest at the beginning.

warning.label: Warning
warning.description: Alert signs are clear. The situation can escalate if not addressed in time. Start low-threshold documentation.

moderate.label: Increased Risk
moderate.description: Signs suggest repeated inappropriate treatment. Don't stay alone with these thoughts, but seek validation from a trusted colleague or friend.

severe.label: Severe Risk
severe.description: This is a serious situation. What you experienced corresponds to systematic bullying. We recommend contacting a union or occupational safety.

critical.label: Critical Emergency
critical.description: This is an emergency for your work ability and health. The situation suggests severe psychological violence. Seek professional help immediately.

critical_signals.title: Critical Observations
critical_signals.itsetunto: Your self-esteem is being tested. This is a typical sign of long-term invalidation.
critical_signals.todellisuus: Gaslighting signs are strong. Don't trust just your memory, document everything.
critical_signals.eristyksissä: Social isolation is detected. This is a common tactic to weaken the person's position.
critical_signals.fyysiset: Physical symptoms are strong. Your body is reacting to chronic stress. Take this seriously.
critical_signals.käyttäytyminen: Changes in behavior suggest high vigilance. You are on high alert.

itsetunto.label: Erosion of Self-Esteem
itsetunto.description: How you feel about yourself and your professional skills.

todellisuus.label: Gaslighting & Reality
todellisuus.description: Do you doubt your own perceptions or memory?

eristyksissä.label: Isolation
eristyksissä.description: Feeling of exclusion or social rejection.

fyysiset.label: Physical Symptoms
fyysiset.description: Body's reactions to mental pressure (sleep, stomach, heart).

käyttäytyminen.label: Behavioral Change
käyttäytyminen.description: How the situation affects your life outside of work.

questions.1: Do you feel stupid at work (even though you are not)?
questions.2: Do you often think: 'Maybe I am too sensitive'?
questions.3: Do you doubt your professional skills (even if you didn't before)?
questions.4: Are you afraid of making mistakes more than before?
questions.5: Do you feel 'too bad' for your job?
questions.6: Have you been told 'I never said that' (even though they did)?
questions.7: Have others questioned your memory ('are you sure?')?
questions.8: Have you been told 'don't take it so hard' / 'it was a joke'?
questions.9: Do you feel that 'going crazy' is possible?
questions.10: Do you write things down because you don't trust your memory?
questions.11: Do you often get left out of meetings (where others are)?
questions.12: Do you notice that no one talks to you on coffee breaks?
questions.13: Do you feel like people are talking behind your back?
questions.14: Have you lost friends/supporters at the workplace?
questions.15: Do you avoid social situations at work?
questions.16: Do you wake up at night thinking about work?
questions.17: Do you have stomach issues before work?
questions.18: Does your heart pound in meetings?
questions.19: Have you been sick more often this year?
questions.20: Do you use alcohol/medication to cope with work pressure?
questions.21: Have you withdrawn socially (outside of work)?
questions.22: Do you cry often without a clear reason?
questions.23: Do you think about resigning daily?
questions.25: Do you feel 'I am not myself anymore'?

tactics_page.description: Bullies often have repeating strategies. When you identify a tactic, it loses some of its power over you.

compare_page.description: Not all corrective feedback is bullying, but bullying should not be hidden under criticism. This table helps you draw the line.
compare_page.rule_text: Constructive criticism focuses on work performance and aims for a solution. Bullying focuses on the employee and aims to harm them as a person.

comparison_points.title: Goal
comparison_points.bullying: To humiliate, control, or force out the employee.
comparison_points.criticism: To improve work quality or correct a wrong procedure.

comparison_points.title: Target
comparison_points.criticism: Performance, work results, or followed instructions.

comparison_points.title: Interaction
comparison_points.bullying: One-sided, aggressive, often in front of others or behind back.

comparison_points.title: Frequency
comparison_points.criticism: Situational and ends when the agreed change is made.

comparison_points.title: Outcome
comparison_points.bullying: Burnout, loss of self-confidence, and anxiety.
comparison_points.criticism: Clarity of expectations and professional development.

mitatointi.name: Invalidation & Belittling
mitatointi.definition: Constant belittling and questioning of your skills, suggestions, and achievements.
phrases: That's a useless suggestion
Do you really not know this?
Anyone could have done that
Why are you making a big deal out of this?
mitatointi.goal: Erode your self-confidence and professional credibility.
strategy: Do not expect recognition from the bully.
mitatointi.logExample: Supervisor said 'useless suggestion' in meeting on 12.12. Witnesses: 5 people.

eristaminen.name: Isolation & Exclusion
eristaminen.definition: Intentional exclusion from social and professional interaction.
phrases: I forgot to tell you that
This doesn't concern you
(Silence when you arrive)
The meeting was yesterday
eristaminen.goal: Make you invisible and cut off your support network.
strategy: Ask in writing why information did not flow.
eristaminen.logExample: Entire team went to lunch without me for 3rd day in a row (10-12.12).

gaslighting.name: Gaslighting
gaslighting.definition: Psychological manipulation that makes you doubt your own perceptions and memory.
phrases: I never said that
You are too sensitive
It was a joke, don't take it hard
You are just imagining things
gaslighting.goal: Make you doubt your sanity and silence you.
strategy: Write things down immediately when they happen.
gaslighting.logExample: 15.12 agreed on X. 18.12 supervisor claimed such thing was never agreed.

passiivi-aggressio.name: Passive-Aggressiveness
passiivi-aggressio.definition: Hidden hostility that is hard to point out directly as bullying.
phrases: Maybe next time you'll succeed better (sarcasm)
I'm just being honest
(Sighing during your turn to speak)
(Rolling eyes)
passiivi-aggressio.goal: Hurt without the bully being held accountable for their behavior.
strategy: Ask directly: 'Did you mean that offensively?'
passiivi-aggressio.logExample: Supervisor rolled eyes during my project presentation. Date X.

kohtuuttomuus.name: Unreasonable Demands
kohtuuttomuus.definition: Setting impossible goals or an inhumane workload.
phrases: This needs to be ready tomorrow (week's work)
Others can do this too
I don't have time to look at prioritization, do it all
Are you slow or why does it take so long?
kohtuuttomuus.goal: Cause burnout or 'prove' your incompetence through failure.
strategy: Keep track of work time and tasks.
kohtuuttomuus.logExample: Received 40h work on Friday at 4 PM, due Monday at 8 AM.

epaoikeudenmukaisuus.name: Unfairness
epaoikeudenmukaisuus.definition: Applying rules and rewards differently to different people.
phrases: A gets remote work, you don't (without reason)
Good project A! (Even though you did the work)
Your mistake is serious (A's same mistake ok)
We don't usually pay extra for this
epaoikeudenmukaisuus.goal: Create uncertainty and signal that you are not equal to others.
strategy: Compare your situation to written guidelines.
Ask in writing for grounds for unequal treatment.
epaoikeudenmukaisuus.logExample: Colleague got credit in team meeting for a project I did alone.

uhkailu.name: Threats & Intimidation
uhkailu.definition: Indirect or direct threatening with loss of employment or reputation.
phrases: I have spoken about you to management
If this repeats, you know the consequences
Maybe this field doesn't suit you
Hopefully you won't make mistakes again...
uhkailu.goal: Control you through fear and prevent defense.
strategy: Do not stay alone with the threatener.
uhkailu.logExample: Supervisor said behind closed doors 'best to start looking for a new job'.

sabotaasi.name: Sabotage
sabotaasi.definition: Intentionally preventing or hindering work performance.
phrases: (Information given wrongly or too late)
I didn't get your message (even though they did)
Project was moved to another in the middle of everything
(Tools not delivered despite request)
sabotaasi.goal: Make you look incompetent and cause frustration.
strategy: Copy important messages to a third party.
Report obstacles immediately along the reporting line.
sabotaasi.logExample: Critical Excel template not delivered, although requested 5 times.

maine.name: Defamation of Reputation
maine.definition: Spreading false rumors or distorting competence to others.
phrases: He/She is a difficult person
No one wants to work with him/her
I heard he/she makes a lot of mistakes
He/She is not a team player
maine.goal: Destroy your credibility and support opportunities in the organization.
strategy: Ask HR to investigate the source of rumors.
maine.logExample: Colleague told that supervisor had spoken of me as 'unstable' in the break room.

manipulaatio.name: Emotional Manipulation
manipulaatio.definition: Using emotions, such as guilt or fear, to control another.
phrases: I thought we were friends
When you are sick, others suffer
You are the only one who can save this
Let's see next week (but never)
manipulaatio.goal: Make you obedient through guilt or false hope.
strategy: Identify the 'good day / bad day' cycle.
Do not take responsibility for another's feelings.
manipulaatio.logExample: Supervisor guilt-tripped about sick leave saying it destroys team spirit.

identiteetti.name: Identity Attack
identiteetti.definition: Attack against personal traits, such as age, gender, or background.
phrases: Are you ADHD or why don't you focus?
Women don't understand this technical side
It's hard for someone that age to learn new things
You are so sensitive today (referring to trait)
identiteetti.goal: Humiliate and show that you don't belong because of a personal reason.
strategy: This can be discrimination breaking the law.
identiteetti.logExample: Supervisor asked 'is the slowness due to your age' in hearing of others.

thousand-cuts.name: Death by a Thousand Cuts
thousand-cuts.definition: Continuous series of small micro-aggressions difficult to isolate individually.
phrases: (Constant small corrections to work)
(Small sighs after your requests)
(Non-existent feedback on done things)
(Small inappropriate jokes daily)
thousand-cuts.goal: Wear out the victim's psyche slowly but surely.
strategy: Document ALL even small things – quantity matters.
Look at the big picture, not just this day.
Seek outside validation for the situation.
thousand-cuts.logExample: 15 small unpleasant encounters within the same day. Depressing feeling.

validate.title: Validation
validate.text: Confirm to yourself that you are not imagining things.

name.title: Naming
name.text: Learn the right terms, like gaslighting or sabotage.

boundaries.title: Setting Boundaries
boundaries.text: Recognize where normal stress ends and bullying begins.

moderate.title: Validate your Experience
moderate.text: Don't wonder alone. Talking with an outsider or trusted entity helps to perceive the situation.
moderate.label: Find Support

moderate.title: Start Logging
moderate.text: Documentation is worth starting with a low threshold. Small notes help form the big picture later.

critical.text: Your health is priority. Contact occupational health or a crisis hotline immediately to decompress the burden.
critical.label: Get Help Now

critical.title: Create Fact Report
critical.text: Your data is stored on your device. Use AI analysis to structure events into an official report.
critical.label: Create Report

hero.title: Support and Recovery
hero.subtitle: Concrete instructions, exercises, and action plans to support your well-being.

phase1.label: Phase 1
phase1.title: Bullying has just started or you're unsure
phase1.description: Act immediately when you notice the first signs.

step1.content: Is it repeated inappropriate treatment? Take the quiz on the home page to be sure. Document specific examples.

step2.content: Don't wait for the 'situation to pass'. Start keeping a log right away (Timeline tool). Without documentation, it's your word against theirs.

step3.content: Talk to a trusted colleague or friend first. Don't stay alone with the matter.

phase2.label: Phase 2
phase2.title: The situation has persisted
phase2.description: When informal methods aren't enough, formal actions are needed.

step1.content: They are an employee representative who knows laws and processes. The discussion is confidential. Ask them to join meetings for support.

step2.trigger: 2. Make a written report to the employer
step2.content: The employer has a statutory obligation to intervene in harassment once they are informed. Make the report in writing (email) so there is a record.

step3.content: If the employer does not intervene, you can contact the Regional State Administrative Agency (AVI).

phase3.label: Phase 3
phase3.title: I am on sick leave due to burnout
phase3.description: Recovery is now your most important job.

step1.content: Sleep, eat, spend time outdoors. Don't think about work matters. Remove work email from your phone. You are safe.

step2.content: Start processing the matter with a professional (occupational psychologist, therapist). Use the Turvasiipi report as a tool.

breathing.title: Stress Management: 5-5-5 Breathing
breathing.description: Activate the parasympathetic nervous system and calm acute anxiety.

grounding.title: Grounding Technique 5-4-3-2-1
grounding.description: When panic hits, bring yourself back to the moment.

boundaries.title: Setting Boundaries
boundaries.description: Learn to say these out loud.

quotes.not_accept: "I don't accept this kind of talk."
quotes.speak_properly: "I request that you speak to me properly."
quotes.not_continue: "I will not continue the discussion if it continues like this."

darvo.title: DARVO Defense
darvo.description: When you face manipulation (Deny, Attack, Reverse Victim).
darvo.attack_text: "You are too sensitive. You have problems."
darvo.response_text: "This is not about me. Let's focus on behavior and facts."

strengths.title: Strength List
strengths.description: A reminder for yourself in weak moments.
strengths.instruction: Write down 3 things you have succeeded in:
strengths.footer: "One bad manager does not define my value."

emergency_kit.title: 📦 Emergency Kit
emergency_kit.description: Save these ready for a bad day.
